description:
Hushfeed v0.58.0 targets global TikTok 47.0.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

This one is mostly fixes from your bug reports. Hide series no longer empties creator profiles. Hide the Tako bubble now also removes the Ask Tako button on the search page. The Save media button is back on comment stickers. The in-app browser privacy switch now warns that it stops Activity center and Watch history from responding, so turn it off if Watch history ignores your taps.

Two new switches cover things TikTok shows only in some regions: Hide the Report button on videos (Feed screen) and Hide search rewards (App). Both are off by default. Settings now come in Turkish too, as a first pass.

Validation: 1584 runtime tests passed locally. All 269 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lint checks. All 91 patches applied to TikTok 47.0.3 and retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures with no manifest changes. Older fixtures are compatibility checks. Use 47.0.3 when patching.

The release-derived APK was tested on the S22 with the same signing key and preserved app data. The series and Tako bugs were reproduced on v0.57.0 first, and all three fixes were checked again on this build. The two regional switches were turned on and the feed and search used without a crash, but TikTok doesn't show those elements to our test account, so their hiding couldn't be seen. All changed settings were restored. The S25 wasn't updated because its signing key differs from the local test key.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
